name: power
description: RULE concepts with useful limits and complications
entries: Thread RULE — Create and control a few meters of thread within sight; stronger fibers require carried material, and control weakens sharply with distance.
Echo RULE — Capture one sound and replay or redirect it; loud sounds cost more AP and only one captured sound can be held at a time.
Rust RULE — Accelerate corrosion on touched non-magical metal; large or well-maintained objects require sustained contact.
Door RULE — Sense and manipulate ordinary doors nearby; cannot create passages or affect a threshold the user cannot clearly imagine.
Weight RULE — Make one visible object somewhat heavier or lighter; cannot reduce weight to zero and requires concentration.
Ink RULE — Animate written ink into moving symbols and simple shapes; destroying the source writing ends the effect.
Momentum RULE — Store a portion of the force from one impact and release it through a later touch; excess stored force injures the user.
Mist RULE — Produce and shape cool fog nearby; wind disperses it and the user cannot see through it naturally.
Borrowed Face RULE — Copy the face of someone touched for one hour; voice, clothing, memories, and mannerisms remain unchanged.
Candle RULE — Control small existing flames and read the strongest emotion of the person who lit one.
Root RULE — Accelerate and guide nearby plant roots; barren ground requires seeds, water, and extra time.
Glass RULE — Bend and reshape touched glass without heat; shattered fragments remain dangerous and mass cannot be created.
Promise RULE — Sense when a willingly spoken promise is broken; cannot force honesty or determine why it was broken.
Friction RULE — Increase or decrease friction across a small visible surface; extremes are brief and affect allies as readily as enemies.
Scent RULE — Create, remove, and follow mundane scents; complex copied scents require a sample.
Paper RULE — Fold paper into briefly animated tools or creatures; water, fire, and heavy force destroy them easily.
Reflection RULE — Look through a nearby reflection or distort what it shows; cannot pass matter through it.
Sleep RULE — Encourage natural sleep in a calm target; pain, danger, or strong stimulation breaks the effect.
Magnetism RULE — Pull or push small ferrous objects; precision and force decrease with range.
Mending RULE — Repair simple breaks in non-living objects; missing material must be supplied and magical properties are not restored.
Shadow RULE — Stretch and shape the user's shadow into distracting forms; it cannot become solid and needs a light source.
Salt RULE — Create and shape a handful of salt; larger quantities cause exhaustion, and summoned salt dissolves by sunrise.
Heartbeat RULE — Sense nearby heartbeats and briefly synchronize with one; constructs and many undead are invisible to it.
Color RULE — Move or alter color on visible surfaces; effects are cosmetic but can enable camouflage or coded signals.
Balance RULE — Stabilize a touched object or willing person against ordinary motion; sudden heavy force can overwhelm it.
Cold RULE — Draw heat from a small nearby area; the displaced heat warms the user's body and can become dangerous.
Memory RULE — Preserve one willing recent memory inside an object; recording fades the user's own details until it is released.
Threshold RULE — Know when a designated boundary is crossed; only one boundary can be watched and it must be physically marked.
Swarm RULE — Communicate simple intentions to a small group of mundane insects; it grants no direct control over unnatural creatures.
Chance RULE — Once per scene, nudge a trivial random outcome; the GM chooses an equally unlikely inconvenience that follows.
